zh: **EPUB 排版保真** — 列表（项目符号/编号/嵌套）、引用块、预格式化与代码块空白、表格结构均按原书保留，不再退化为纯文本
**EPUB 元数据提取** — 读取出版社、出版日期、语言、简介与封面，写入书籍信息
**EPUB 转换进度** — 转换期间显示进度提示，大型书籍不再表现为界面无响应
**EPUB 转换缓存** — 转换结果缓存，再次打开同一本书无需重新解析
**EPUB 生成封面页与结束页** — 缺失封面时自动生成，阅读体验更完整
**EPUB 分页改用 PaginationCalculator** — 替换原先硬编码的每页 100 行，分页结果与正文一致
**修复 EPUB 目录锚点** — 保留 TOC fragment 锚点，收紧 EPUB3 nav 检测，跳转定位更准确
**修复 EPUB 误识别** — 错名 .epub 文件在降级为 TXT 前先校验文本特征；超大 EPUB 的大小限制提示不再被重复通知覆盖
**修复 EPUB 段落间距与首行缩进** — 排版设置对 EPUB 正文正确生效
**安全加固** — 修复换行混淆 href 绕过黑名单的 XSS，并净化 EPUB 解析后的链接与内联属性
**修复分页崩溃** — `#handleLongChapters` 在非标题分页点崩溃；`formatBytes_simple` 对非有限数值回退
**工程与测试** — 引入 ESLint + Prettier（非阻塞）；新增 EPUB 转换器与渲染两组单元测试；CI 新增 EdgeOne Pages 部署与 GitHub 同步
en: **EPUB layout fidelity** — lists (bullets/numbering/nesting), blockquotes, preformatted & code whitespace, and tables are preserved as structured markup instead of degrading to plain text
**EPUB metadata extraction** — publisher, date, language, description and cover are read into book info
**EPUB conversion progress** — a progress indicator is shown during conversion so large books no longer look frozen
**EPUB conversion caching** — converted results are cached; reopening the same book skips re-parsing
**EPUB generated cover and end pages** — auto-generated when absent, for a more complete reading experience
**EPUB pagination now uses PaginationCalculator** — replaces the hardcoded 100-lines-per-page split so results match body text
**Fixed EPUB TOC anchors** — preserve TOC fragment anchors and tighten EPUB3 nav detection for accurate jump targets
**Fixed EPUB misdetection** — misnamed .epub files are validated for text characteristics before falling back to TXT; oversized-EPUB size-limit notices are no longer hidden by duplicate toasts
**Fixed EPUB paragraph spacing and first-line indent** — typography settings now apply correctly to EPUB body text
**Security hardening** — fixed an XSS bypass where newline-obfuscated hrefs slipped past the blacklist, and sanitized resolved EPUB links plus allowed inline attributes
**Fixed pagination crashes** — `#handleLongChapters` crashed on non-title page breaks; `formatBytes_simple` now falls back for non-finite values
**Tooling & tests** — added ESLint + Prettier (non-blocking); new unit tests for the EPUB converter and rendering; CI gained EdgeOne Pages deploy and GitHub sync workflows

zh: **配置同步改为手动按需模式** — 移除启动自动拉取、周期轮询与保存时自动推送，改为设置面板「拉取 / 推送」按钮显式触发，从根本上避免本地修改被远端覆盖
**同步令牌 UI** — 新增令牌格式校验（仅字母、数字、下划线，4–64 位）与拉取 / 推送动作的即时状态反馈
**自动拼接重写** — 重构为仅累积的连续滚动（accumulate-only continuous scroll），修正旧实现的已知 BUG
**修复正则越界** — 广告过滤规则中对书名 / 作者中的正则元字符进行转义，避免规则崩溃
⚠️ **同步数据格式为 v2（字段级时间戳），与 1.x 客户端不兼容** — 多设备请统一升级到 ≥2.0.0，旧客户端读取 v2 数据会失败
**构建与部署加固** — Vite 产物文件名加入内容哈希；统一使用 pnpm 管理依赖（移除 package-lock.json）；Docker 镜像改用 Caddy 静态服务并移除已失效的 8866 端口
en: **Config sync is now manual on-demand** — removed boot auto-pull, periodic polling and auto-push-on-save; pull/push are explicit buttons in the settings panel, eliminating accidental remote overwrites
**Sync token UI** — added token format validation (alphanumeric + underscore, 4–64 chars) and live status feedback for pull/push actions
**Auto-join rewrite** — reimplemented as accumulate-only continuous scroll, fixing known bugs in the old implementation
**Fixed regex overflow** — escape regex metacharacters in book name / author for the ad-filter rules to prevent crashes
⚠️ **Sync data format is v2 (field-level timestamps), NOT compatible with 1.x clients** — upgrade all devices to ≥2.0.0; old clients fail to read v2 data

**Build & deploy hardening** — Vite asset filenames now include a content hash; dependencies unified under pnpm (removed package-lock.json); Docker image uses Caddy static serving and drops the obsolete :8866 port

zh: **修复 T2S 繁简转换四大问题**
— 设置互斥竞态：勾选 Pro 模式时 Lite 的 onApply 在持久化前覆盖 Pro 值
— OpenCC CDN 被跟踪防护拦截：下载至本地 `client/lib/opencc/full.js` 彻底消除第三方依赖
— 渲染时序：T2S Hook 在内容显示后才执行，用户看到繁体文本才需刷新才变简体
— 工作线程覆盖：剩余内容处理完成后 `FILE_CONTENT_CHUNKS` 被原始数据覆盖触发繁体重渲染
修复 OpenCC 动态 `import()` 路径：UMD 模块无法通过 `import()` 加载，简化为 `<script>` 标签注入
en: **Fixed four critical T2S conversion issues**
— Setting mutual exclusion race: Lite's onApply overrides Pro before persist
— OpenCC CDN blocked by tracking prevention: download to `client/lib/opencc/full.js`
— Render timing: T2S hook ran after content display (needs refresh)
— Worker overwrite: remaining content processing replaced converted data with raw data
Fixed dynamic import() for UMD module, simplified to script-tag injection

zh: **繁简转换 (T2S)** — 内置 OpenCC 繁简映射 2928 对，支持轻型（本地映射表）和重型（OpenCC JS 完整版 CDN）两种模式
**排版预设系统** — 内置 6 种预设（默认/阅读/简洁/护眼/杂志/代码），支持 URL 参数切换（?scheme=0/1/Name）
**构建预分页** — 构建时自动预分页 EPUB/TXT 书籍，大幅减少首次加载计算量
**配置同步** — 支持跨设备配置同步，pullOnBoot 非阻塞加载，mergeSyncedConfig 过滤未知键
**生产构建优化** — Vite 构建自动复制 Worker 依赖到 dist/，修复 CSS 路径和 Worker URL 解析
**全面测试覆盖** — 285 个单元测试（11 个测试文件），涵盖 T2S、预设、预分页、Hook、配置同步、Worker 解析等
修复 OpenCC CDN URL 指向 opencc-js@1.1.7（HTTP 200 验证）
修复 锬 等占位映射（仅 1 个，映射 錟→锬），其余 2927 对均正确
修复 Auto-detect 模式下 processedLines 对象行采样
修复 EPUB DOMParser polyfill（预分页兼容 Node.js）
修复 settings 对象从 settings.js 正确导出
修复配置同步中的未知键反馈回路
en: **T2S (Traditional to Simplified)** — Built-in OpenCC mapping with 2928 pairs, supports lightweight (local map) and heavy (OpenCC JS full via CDN) modes
**Typography preset system** — 6 built-in presets (Default/Reading/Compact/Eye-care/Magazine/Code), switchable via URL params (?scheme=0/1/Name)
**Build-time pre-pagination** — EPUB/TXT books pre-paginated at build time, drastically reducing first-load computation
**Config sync** — Cross-device configuration sync with non-blocking pullOnBoot and unknown-key filtering in mergeSyncedConfig
**Production build optimization** — Vite build auto-copies Worker deps to dist/, fixes CSS path and Worker URL resolution
**Comprehensive test coverage** — 285 unit tests (11 test files) covering T2S, presets, pre-pagination, hooks, config sync, worker resolution, and more
Fixed OpenCC CDN URL pointing to opencc-js@1.1.7 (HTTP 200 verified)
Fixed placeholder mapping for 锬 (only 1, maps 錟→锬), remaining 2927 pairs correct
Fixed processedLines object row sampling in auto-detect mode
Fixed EPUB DOMParser polyfill for Node.js pre-pagination compatibility
Fixed settings object export from settings.js

**EPUB 跨章节链接** — 行内内部链接（#fragment / chapter.xhtml#sec）可点击跳转到对应章节位置
**EPUB 内联 SVG** — 内联 <svg> 序列化为沙箱 data URL 渲染（浏览器强制禁用脚本），超大 SVG 降级占位
**工程与测试** — 新增 25 项 EPUB 图片单元测试；修复 CI workflow 步骤顺序；多轮独立代码审查与 Bug 修复
en: **EPUB image rendering** — EPUB images are inlined as base64 data URLs (PNG/JPEG/GIF/SVG/WebP/AVIF/BMP), supporting standalone images, figure+figcaption, and inline images in paragraphs; external image URLs are blocked for privacy
**EPUB image pagination precision** — page breaks shift before images to prevent splitting, oversized images scaled with max-height:80vh
**EPUB missing image fallback** — un-inlineable images show a dashed placeholder (with alt text) instead of being silently dropped
**EPUB style fidelity** — controlled inline styles preserved (text-align/text-indent/font-style/font-weight/margin) with value-level regex validation against CSS injection
**EPUB footnote restoration** — epub:type="footnote" asides and noteref links are recognized, with hover popup display
**EPUB cross-chapter links** — internal links (#fragment / chapter.xhtml#sec) are clickable and jump to the target chapter position
**EPUB inline SVG** — inline <svg> serialized as sandboxed data URL (browser-enforced script disable), oversized SVG degrades to placeholder
**Engineering & tests** — 25 new EPUB image unit tests; fixed CI workflow step ordering; multiple rounds of independent code review and bug fixes
